status_semantics.freeze_rule: FROZEN_PRE_GPU was permitted only after the exact prepared manifest, construction gates, learned AUC probes, and tokenizer audit all validated.
status_semantics.launch_rule: The frozen protocol never authorizes a GPU by itself; a separate fail-closed launch receipt must bind data, model, tokenizer, code, schedule, environment, and tests.
status_semantics.amendment_policy: After freezing, never edit this file in place; create a versioned amendment before any affected run.

objective.question: Does one-way support-preserving consistency regularization improve multi-hop answer and evidence stability under non-support document replacement while retaining clean-context answering and evidence-insufficiency refusal?
objective.training_class: parameter-efficient supervised post-training with deterministic auxiliary regularization
prohibited: checkpoint selection on dev, shadow, or official data

forbidden_for_entire_pilot: every official MuSiQue dev member or extracted dev file
every official MuSiQue test member or extracted test file
labels, predictions, prompts, or scores derived from official dev/test
model-generated gold answers or support labels
access_boundary.unit_test_policy: Tests use synthetic fixtures plus allowlisted manifests/audits; no test may open the sealed-shadow body or official dev/test.

C.target: official final answer plus the official supporting paragraph indices
C.eligibility: all decomposition support indices are valid C support flags and equal the support-flag set

M.source: official paired unanswerable row with the same id, question, answer, and decomposition as C
M.eligibility: omits at least one raw-text SHA256 from C support and at least one decomposition subanswer token sequence

D.intervention: replace exactly two C non-support slots with leak-filtered C-nonsupport donors from different orbits in the same split
preserved: all C support paragraphs byte-for-byte and in their original slots
donor_constraints: no target answer, alias, or decomposition-subanswer token sequence
length, duplication, coherence, and question-overlap matching

component_edges: shared raw C support paragraph-text SHA256
shared normalized answer, either alias list item, or decomposition subanswer
split_contract.assignment: deterministic exact-size subset-sum over whole components, independently salted by split

construction: 2,720/2,720 orbits replace exactly two non-support slots in D
2,720/2,720 preserve every C support paragraph byte-for-byte in D
2,720/2,720 preserve the exact C target in D

learned_surface_probe.features: 18 state-blind document surface/structure features; no question, answer, support flag, provenance, or state label
learned_surface_probe.classifier: orbit-grouped deterministic 5-fold OOF StandardScaler plus logistic regression
learned_surface_probe.gate: max(raw ROC AUC, 1-raw ROC AUC) <= 0.60 for every pair

semantic_diagnostic_probe.features: surface family plus question-document lexical overlap; no answer-derived feature
semantic_diagnostic_probe.D_M_and_C_M: diagnostic only because missing evidence is a real semantic distinction

required: prepared rendering byte-identical to canonical rendering

independent_release_validation.construction_invariants: 2720/2720 for exact two-slot replacement, support preservation, C/D target identity, and same-split donors; donor length-ratio violations=0

output_contract.parser: full-string strict grammar; P00-P19 only; ascending unique evidence IDs; no repair or substring recovery

HopPAIR.kl_scope: token mean over exactly shared C/D completion ordinals and the full vocabulary; C is stop-gradient teacher

arms.sft_definition: mean completion-token CE within each state followed by an unweighted mean over C, D, and M
arms.single_forward: Every microstep concatenates one atomic orbit as three C/D/M rows in one model forward for both arms.

matched_training_contract.model_and_tokenizer_hashes: required in the separate launch receipt
matched_training_contract.schedule_algorithm: sort orbit IDs by SHA256(str(seed) + newline + orbit_id)
exact_arm_equalities: base and LoRA initialization within each seed
optimizer, scheduler, LoRA, precision, and finite-guard settings

initialization_audit.pre_gpu: bind the base-model hash, seed, LoRA specification, initialization code hash, schedule hash, and no-resume policy
initialization_audit.pre_dev_generation: after both training runs but before any trained-arm dev generation, require exact equality of the recorded initial_trainable_parameters_sha256 values

decoding.budget_exhausted_rows: record exactly; no output-dependent extension or 256-token replacement run is allowed under v1

metrics.answer_f1: official MuSiQue normalization with maximum over answer plus aliases
metrics.cd_min_f1: per-orbit min(C answer F1, D answer F1)
metrics.orbit_answer_suff_f1: cd_min_f1 only when C and D answer and M refuses; otherwise zero
metrics.orbit_support_suff_f1: min(C support F1, D support F1) under the same C-answer/D-answer/M-refuse event; otherwise zero
metrics.false_refusal_rate: mean refusal indicator over C and D
metrics.parse_rate: strict full-string parse rate over C/D/M

gates_from_support_orbit_metrics_v1.rule: delta >= +0.04 and paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
delta >= +0.04 and paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
all cryptographic bindings and runtime checks true

development_evaluation.seed_escalation: Run seed 17 first under the v1 canonical receipt/output roots. On STOP, end the route. On GO, run predeclared seeds 29 and 43 under separate versioned receipts, code locks, and output roots; they may not overwrite seed 17. Shadow remains sealed unless all three seed comparisons are GO.

shadow.open_condition: 3/3 frozen-seed dev comparisons return GO with complete integrity
shadow.evaluation: one shot under a separately frozen shadow receipt; no threshold, prompt, checkpoint, seed, or decoding changes

official_dev_and_test.open_condition: not authorized by this protocol; requires a later protocol after shadow success

RAFT.reference: RAFT: Adapting Language Model to Domain Specific RAG, COLM 2024
RAFT.establishes: open-book supervised adaptation with oracle evidence, distractors, and evidence-citing answers
RAFT.does_not_establish_here: HopPAIR's paired C/D/M construction, one-way completion KL, or sufficiency action margin

Trust-Align.reference: Measuring and Enhancing Trustworthiness of LLMs in RAG through Grounded Attributions and Learning to Refuse, ICLR 2025
Trust-Align.establishes: the importance of jointly evaluating answer quality, citations, and refusal, and a preference-alignment route
Trust-Align.does_not_establish_here: official Trust-Score performance or a preference-trained result; this pilot uses neither Trust-Data nor DPO

CORD.reference: CORD: Balancing COnsistency and Rank Distillation for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation, NAACL 2025 Short Papers
CORD.establishes: consistency regularization across position-perturbed RAG contexts and the risk of blind consistency when rank priors matter
CORD.does_not_establish_here: novelty of KL consistency itself; HopPAIR instead studies support-preserving non-support replacement, one-way clean anchoring, and an answer-versus-refuse margin

GRACE.reference: GRACE: Reinforcement Learning for Grounded Response and Abstention under Contextual Evidence, arXiv:2601.04525 (preprint)
GRACE.establishes: a contemporary RL route combining evidence grounding and abstention with gated rewards
GRACE.does_not_establish_here: peer-reviewed authority for HopPAIR, an RL claim, a reward-model claim, or state-of-the-art performance

literature_and_novelty_boundary.allowed_novelty_statement: A controlled pilot of support-preserving paired consistency and evidence-sufficiency margin training on official multi-hop answerable/unanswerable pairs.
literature_and_novelty_boundary.forbidden_novelty_statement: first consistency-trained RAG model, first grounded-refusal method, or first distractor-aware RAG post-training method

claim_boundary.C: official MuSiQue answerable context and annotations
claim_boundary.M: official paired unanswerable context that passes explicit missing-support and missing-subanswer filters; not a proof that no parametric-memory answer is possible
claim_boundary.D: synthetic support-preserving replacement of exactly two non-support paragraphs; not a real retriever output, verified adversarial hard negative, or ranking benchmark
claim_boundary.pilot_result: internal held-out train-derived post-training evidence only
claim_boundary.allowed_after_three_seed_dev_and_shadow_: HopPAIR improved the frozen orbit-level answer/evidence-sufficiency metrics under this MuSiQue-derived intervention while satisfying clean-C, refusal, support, parse, and integrity gates.
forbidden_without_later_protocol: semantic entailment improvement beyond the frozen answer/support metrics

required_bindings: prepared manifest SHA256 and READY data-gate evidence
train/dev artifact SHA256 without opening shadow
base-model and tokenizer hashes, chat-template hash, EOS and pad IDs
same seed-specific orbit schedule hash for both arms
deterministic initialization specification: seed, base hash, LoRA configuration, initialization code hash, and no-resume policy
forbidden-access assertions for shadow and official dev/test
